name: EPIC 212281705
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 10.6 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,930 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.96 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,914 K at its surface.
